answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 63831 Country: Pakistan Title: What is right age to start Hifz-e-Quran? Question: My child is 6 years old. I need to know the right age for Hifz-e-Quran. Please guide me at what age should I start his Hifz, he has now started his nazrah as well. Answer ID: 63831 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 339/339/SD=05/1437) There is no age limitation for starting Hifz course. When the child completes nazirah and is able to pronounce the words correctly then he may start Hifz with the advice of the concerned teacher. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
